mapper.select:
select r.* from risk r left join tb_user u on u.user_id=r.user_id where 1=1
and u.user_name like concat('%',#{userName},'%')
and u.phone like concat('%',#{phone},'%')
and r.risk_type=#{riskType}
order by r.create_time desc

select user_id as userId,counts, (select count(*) from risk s where s.user_id=a.user_id and risk_type=1) as ipCount, (select count(*) from risk s where s.user_id=a.user_id and risk_type=2) as talkCount, (select count(*) from risk s where s.user_id=a.user_id and risk_type=3) as talkCommentCount, (select count(*) from risk s where s.user_id=a.user_id and risk_type=4) as serviceCommentCount, (select count(*) from risk s where s.user_id=a.user_id and risk_type=5) as chatCount, (select count(*) from risk s where s.user_id=a.user_id and risk_type=6) as messageCount from ( select count(*) as counts ,r.user_id from risk r left join tb_user u on r.user_id=u.user_id where 1=1
and u.user_name like concat('%',#{userName},'%')
and u.phone like concat('%',#{phone},'%')
group by r.user_id ) a
order by counts desc
order by ipCount desc
order by talkCount desc
order by talkCommentCount desc
order by serviceCommentCount desc
order by chatCount desc
order by messageCount desc
